changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Soft-delete duplicate earnings records (keep the most recent one)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE earnings e1 SET deleted_at = NOW(), deleted_by = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' WHERE e1.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM earnings e2 WHERE e2.worker_id = e1.worker_id AND e2.furniture_order_id = e1.furniture_order_id AND e2.earn_date = e1.earn_date AND e2.deleted_at IS NULL AND e2.id > e1.id )

SELECT COUNT(*) as duplicate_count FROM ( SELECT worker_id, furniture_order_id, earn_date, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM earnings WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY worker_id, furniture_order_id, earn_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates
